name: service-bay-vr-api
description: Teacher dashboard API for Service Bay VR: a Cloudflare Worker with a D1 database.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply service-bay-vr --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.dev:e2e: wrangler d1 migrations apply service-bay-vr --local && wrangler dev --port 8787 --ip 127.0.0.1 --var RATE_LIMIT_SCALE:1000
